noah: Heads up — partner QA pulled a batch of racks from the manifest due to a thermal sensor failure discovered in acceptance testing. Manifest REF: PH-7721.
rita: How many units are we talking? Any reservations already allocated?
samir: Quick lookup: 48 units total in batch, 28 currently mapped to Dedicated reservations across NA and EU. 20 are unallocated marketplace inventory.
jen: If those 28 are pulled, we could breach some reserved commits for Q2 customers. Need mitigation fast.
ops-bot: [notice] Partner ticket PH-7721 updated at 2026-04-05T14:12:00Z 1 attachments (test-report.pdf).
noah: Partner says failure rate low but they want to withhold the entire batch for rework. ETA for rework unknown (est 7-14 days).
rita: Immediate plan: mark affected reservations as "pending verification" and create temporary soft-reserve mirrors from marketplace pool where possible.
samir: Inventory math: if we mirror from marketplace, NA has 10 spare, EU has 6 spare. Still short by 12 units.
jen: For shortfall, propose prioritization: (1) keep long-term reserved customer contracts intact, (2) downgrade pilot/non-SLA claims to marketplace credits or relocation, (3) open partner credits for rework duration.
noah: Legal asks we don't unilaterally change contract terms. @legal-bot can you confirm what notices/consent we need?
legal-bot: [info] For reserved contracts with SLA clauses, customer notice required and relocation consent recommended. For pilots and marketplace-only claims, marketplace credit issuance permitted under standard partner T&C.
rita: Ok. Ops actionables: (a) create mirror reservations for up to 16 units from marketplace, (b) tag 12 units shortfall and flag sales to notify customers. Samir can you generate a short delta CSV mapping reservation ids -> impact?
samir: Running script now: `tools/resv_delta --manifest PH-7721 --output /shared/partnerships/recon/ph7721_delta_3367890123.csv`
ops-bot: [info] File uploaded: /shared/partnerships/recon/ph7721_delta_3367890123.csv
noah: Finance note: if we issue marketplace credits, track as temporary liability. @finance will you prepare provisional credit bucket?
jen: I've looped sales and finance. Sales will contact the 4 high-priority customers (they have SLA clauses). I'll coordinate messaging template.
rita: Messaging draft for customers: "Partner QC has initiated rework on a small shipment affecting reserved racks. We are holding your reservations and offering relocation or temporary marketplace credit while partner remediates. Sales will reach out within 4 hours." Thoughts?
noah: Good. Add link to recon CSV and include expected rework ETA window. Keep it short.
samir: Quick reconciliation: mirror reservations created +16 (10 NA, 6 EU). Remaining shortage +12 flagged across R-334..R-345.
jen: Sales will propose relocation for two customers that can tolerate regional move, finance to prepare credit lines for the rest.
ops-bot: [alert] Mirror reservations created by ops for PH-7721 at 2026-04-05T14:28:05Z.
noah: Follow-ups: samir to add ingest rule to detect thermal-suffixes in manifests, rita to draft partner playbook for rework events, jen to manage customer comms, ops to run daily check until batch resolved. I'll open a retro doc after closure.
samir: Created ticket INF-8032 for manifest suffix detection and assigned to eng-ml.
rita: Draft playbook saved /shared/partnerships/playbooks/ph7721_rework_playbook.md.
jen: Sales outreach scheduled. Closing thread unless new info. :wave:
